exposure: Awareness and perspective of cesarean section on maternal request (CSMR)
outcome: Willingness to request CS without physician's recommendation
cohort: 752 women attending antenatal clinic at Ekiti State University Teaching Hospital (EKSUTH), Ado-Ekiti
finding: Only 6.4% of respondents were willing to request CS without medical indication, primarily motivated by fear of losing the baby during labor, delay in conception, and fear of labor pains.
